items.text: Its chair and several of its members cosponsored a bill to repeal the national income, payroll, and inheritance taxes and replace them with a national sales tax.
Several of its members, including a former chair, cosponsored a bill letting workers everywhere in the country decline to join or pay a union as a condition of employment.
